description: Retrieve Social Fetch account data and public profiles across supported social platforms.

auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Social Fetch API key sent in the x-api-key header. Sign up and get your key at https://app.socialfetch.dev/playground.

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Get the Social Fetch user associated with the connected API key.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for reading the authenticated Social Fetch account.

id.description: The internal Social Fetch user identifier.

anyOf.description: The user's display name when available.

name.description: The user's display name when available.

anyOf.description: The user's email address when available.

email.description: The user's email address when available.

requestId.description: The request identifier used for support and tracing.

creditsCharged.description: The number of Social Fetch credits charged for the request.

version.description: The Social Fetch API version that served the request.

cached.description: Whether Social Fetch served the response from its shared cache.

meta.description: Metadata returned with a Social Fetch API response.

outputSchema.description: The authenticated Social Fetch account response.

actions.name: get_balance
actions.description: Get the remaining Social Fetch credit balance and billing state.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for reading the Social Fetch credit balance.

balance.description: The total spendable Social Fetch credit balance.

payg.description: The total pay-as-you-go credit bucket, including grace credits.

paygSpendable.description: The pay-as-you-go credits currently available to spend.

graceDebtCredits.description: The grace credits used during the current refill episode.

anyOf.description: The automatic refill state when auto-refill is enabled.

refillState.description: The automatic refill state when auto-refill is enabled.

subscriptionIncludedRemaining.description: The subscription credits remaining in the current period.

subscriptionIncludedTotal.description: The subscription credits granted for the current period.

periodEnd.description: The ISO 8601 end time of the current subscription period.

anyOf.description: The active subscription summary for subscribed accounts.

subscription.description: The active subscription summary for subscribed accounts.

requestId.description: The request identifier used for support and tracing.

creditsCharged.description: The number of Social Fetch credits charged for the request.

version.description: The Social Fetch API version that served the request.

cached.description: Whether Social Fetch served the response from its shared cache.

meta.description: Metadata returned with a Social Fetch API response.

outputSchema.description: The Social Fetch credit balance response.

actions.name: get_profile
actions.description: Get a public profile or channel by handle from a supported social platform.

platform.description: The social platform containing the public profile.

handle.description: The public profile handle, with or without a leading at sign.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for a Social Fetch profile lookup.

lookupStatus.description: The outcome reported by Social Fetch for the lookup.

anyOf.description: The platform-specific profile or channel returned by Social Fetch.

profile.description: The platform-specific profile or channel returned by Social Fetch.

anyOf.description: The platform-specific profile metrics returned by Social Fetch.

metrics.description: The platform-specific profile metrics returned by Social Fetch.

raw.description: The complete platform-specific data object returned by Social Fetch.

requestId.description: The request identifier used for support and tracing.

creditsCharged.description: The number of Social Fetch credits charged for the request.

version.description: The Social Fetch API version that served the request.

cached.description: Whether Social Fetch served the response from its shared cache.

meta.description: Metadata returned with a Social Fetch API response.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Social Fetch profile lookup response.
